query: CHP olağanüstü kurultay çağrı heyeti Sulh Hukuk Mahkemesi başvuru karar - latest status as of late June / early July 2026. Has Özgür Özel's team filed the application under Civil Code Art 75 requesting appointment of a 3-person çağrı heyeti to convene a CHP extraordinary congress? Has any court issued a decision?
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the summary:

**Bottom line:** 
- **Application filed: YES.** Özgür Özel's team filed with the **Ankara Sulh Hukuk Mahkemesi** on **July 14, 2026** (announced July 13) under **TMK Article 75/2**, requesting a **three-person çağrı heyeti** plus an interim measure (tedbir) to convene the CHP extraordinary congress.
- **Court decision: NOT YET** as of the latest reporting (July 14, 2026). No ruling on the çağrı heyeti application had been reported.

**Key facts:** Based on 833 notarized delegate signatures (>2/3 of congress) delivered June 17, 2026; party HQ under restored leader Kılıçdaroğlu didn't act within the 15-day bylaw window.

**Timing caveat:** The question's "late June/early July" framing is slightly off — the çağrı heyeti filing was actually July 13–14. The late-June activity was a *separate* track: on **June 26, 2026** the İstinaf (Regional Appeals Court) rejected a different "clarification of ruling" application related to a tedbir kararı blocking the congress.

key_facts: Özgür Özel's team FILED the çağrı heyeti application with the Ankara Sulh Hukuk Mahkemesi on July 14, 2026 (announced July 13, 2026).
The application is based on Turkish Civil Code (TMK/Türk Medeni Kanunu) Article 75/2.

The request is for appointment of a three-person çağrı heyeti (calling committee) of delegates to convene the CHP olağanüstü kurultay, plus an interim measure (tedbir kararı) to let it begin immediately.
833 CHP congress delegates submitted notarized signatures — more than two-thirds of total congress membership — delivered to party HQ on June 17, 2026.
Party HQ under restored leader Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu did not convene the congress within the 15-day bylaw period, triggering the court application.
CHP spokesperson Zeynel Emre said the committee's authority is limited only to convening the congress (no payments beyond salary, no administrative operations).
NO court decision on the TMK 75 çağrı heyeti application had been reported as of July 14, 2026 — sources report only the filing.
Separate/prior track: On June 26, 2026 the İstinaf (Regional Court of Appeals) rejected a different 'kararın açıklanması' (clarification of ruling) application, finding no ambiguity in the judgment.
The related CHP 38th Ordinary İstanbul Provincial Congress case was postponed to October 16, 2026 (reported July 10, 2026).
The broader context is the CHP 'mutlak butlan' (absolute nullity) crisis after which Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu returned as CHP chairman.
